subject: Re: Kickoff: FM4TLP transfer benchmark track
body:
Anders — resourcing.

Staffing: Rosa 40% front-loaded for the env work, Ondrej 50%, Gustavo 50%, Bilal 30% from April. The conda/graph-tool environment is as fiddly as advertised — Rosa already hit the documented issue where the activated env doesn't pick up the right python binary, so she's baking the working alias into a container image for everyone.

Compute: the April repro runs on titan best-effort (single-node, the pinned torch 2.3.0+cu118 stack). The June internal-domain runs are the heavy part — full transfer matrices across both domains with per-epoch retraining — and for that we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-29, 256 accelerators, which Ines's team confirmed against our portfolio's quarterly allocation.

Storage: 4TB for temporal graph snapshots. Constraint: the June experiment grid must be final by Jun 19 so the reserved week is fully productive.

Daniela
